mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with improved corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity picks up.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances following sustained HOUST increases, or HOUST increases do not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic output.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases do not correlate with reduced economic output.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1 growth does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenues are expected to rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increases do not correlate with rising corporate revenues.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% MoM, it signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity strengthens.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of strong PAYEMS and decreasing UNRATE does not correlate with strengthening economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic output and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances following sustained INDPRO decreases, or INDPRO decreases do not correlate with reduced economic output and corporate earnings.
